meta.decalSpin: plane basis u, v, normal. Normals are real, not axis aligned (curved hulls). wall: u = up x normal, v = normal x u (image top = world up). floor: u = +x, v = -z. ceiling: u = +x, v = normal x u. Spin is counter-clockwise around the normal, size = [along u, along v]
meta.kitAxes: local +y out of the surface it sits on
